verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is payments and checkout infrastructure that lets third-party AI agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) buy on behalf of shoppers, so a background-automation axis is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows a user configuring automations that run autonomously in the background. Webhooks, automatic feed syncing and Adyen-handled checkout orchestration are platform-side integration mechanics, not user-defined autonomous workflows.
